_about: Legal documents v2.0 (Director 27.09.2026: professional level, GDPR, school data protection officer gdpr@idss.ba, +387 33 267 965). Facts confirmed by the Director: free for IDSS students; consent through the enrolment documents; retention until the end of the school year of Grade 9 plus one year; Gemini receives catalogue and query text only. IDSS identity (address, ID number, MBSU) and the governing court confirmed by the Director 27.09.2026; retention of security records "u skladu sa zakonom". Open: legal review by the school before production (AMB-20).

sections.heading: 1. Scope and acceptance
paragraphs: These terms govern the use of the application IDSS - External Graduate Examination (the application), operated for its students and staff by Internationale Deutsche Schule Sarajevo (IDSS or the school).

Operator of the application: Private institution "INTERNATIONALE DEUTSCHE SCHULE SARAJEVO" - Međunarodna Njemačka Škola Sarajevo, Buka 13, 71000 Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina; ID number 4202220420007; registration number (MBSU) 65-05-0013-16; telephone +387 33 560 520; info@idss.ba; www.idss.edu.ba.
By signing in, users confirm that they have read these terms, the Privacy Policy and the Cookie notice. For students, parents or guardians accept these terms as part of enrolment at IDSS.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of the application
paragraphs: The application prepares Grade 9 students for the external graduate examination in Sarajevo Canton in three subjects: Bosnian, Croatian, Serbian Language and Literature, Mathematics, and German as the first foreign language.

The application is an educational tool of the school. It is not part of the official examination procedure, does not issue official results and does not replace official information from the Ministry of Education of Sarajevo Canton. The Ministry's regulations and announcements are authoritative for the official examination rules.

sections.heading: 3. Users and accounts
paragraphs: The application is used by IDSS students, their teachers, specialist staff and school management. Accounts are opened and closed by the school; self-registration is not possible. Rights in the application depend on the user's role and are assigned by the school.
items: An account is personal and must not be passed on to anyone else.
Users must keep their password secret, use a password they do not use for other services, and change it under My account as soon as they suspect someone knows it.
Suspected misuse of an account must be reported immediately to the school or to ai@idss.ba.
After several failed sign-in attempts an account is temporarily locked to protect the user.

sections.heading: 4. Content, sources and intellectual property
paragraphs: Questions, answers and examination rules are taken from the official examination catalogues of the Ministry of Education of Sarajevo Canton and are shown with their source and page. Rights to these materials remain with their publishers; the application uses them solely for educational purposes and without changing their meaning.

IDSS teachers review the content before students use it, and every correction is recorded with its reason and the name of the person who confirmed it. Content may nevertheless contain errors. Users report an error to the subject teacher or to ai@idss.ba.
The software, design and IDSS marks belong to IDSS. Copying, downloading or distributing the content of the application beyond learning at IDSS is not permitted.

sections.heading: 5. Practice, mock examinations and grading
paragraphs: Students see the solution of a task only after submitting their own answer, and for a mock examination only after the teacher has graded it.

Mock examinations are graded by the subject teacher. The system may propose points for closed tasks, but the final grade is always confirmed by the teacher. Results in the application are not official examination results and do not affect secondary school admission.
Points, levels, missions and awards serve motivation. They reward regularity and effort, do not replace the teacher's grade and cannot be exchanged for money or other benefits.

sections.heading: 6. Search of official materials
paragraphs: Search and explanations in the application rely exclusively on reviewed official materials and always cite the source. When the source does not contain an answer, the application says so clearly instead of guessing.
Do not enter personal data (names, grades, health or family information) in the search field. The query text may be processed for the search by the service provider named in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 7. Rules of conduct
paragraphs: Users must not:
items: access or attempt to access other people's data, accounts or parts of the application they have no right to;
circumvent security measures, probe for vulnerabilities or disrupt the application;
enter offensive, discriminatory or unlawful content;
download the content of the application automatically or publish it outside the school;
impersonate another person or use someone else's account.

sections.heading: 8. Measures in case of breach
paragraphs: If these terms are breached, the school may temporarily restrict or close the account and apply the IDSS rules of conduct and disciplinary measures. Actions in the application are recorded and may be used to establish the facts.

sections.heading: 9. Availability and liability
paragraphs: IDSS strives to keep the application reliable and available, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability. The application may be temporarily unavailable because of maintenance, upgrades or technical problems at service providers.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, IDSS is not liable for damage caused by temporary unavailability of the application or by relying on practice results as if they were official examination results.

sections.heading: 10. Personal data protection
paragraphs: The processing of personal data is governed by the Privacy Policy, which forms part of these terms. Questions about personal data are handled by the IDSS data protection officer: gdpr@idss.ba, telephone +387 33 267 965.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: IDSS may change these terms because of changes in regulations, the application or its organisation. Users are informed of material changes in the application before they take effect. The current version and its date are shown at the end of the document.

sections.heading: 12. Governing law and contact
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the law of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The court in Sarajevo has jurisdiction over disputes.
Questions about the application and these terms: ai@idss.ba.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: This policy explains which personal data the application IDSS - External Graduate Examination processes, for which purposes, on which legal basis, with whom it is shared, how long it is kept and which rights the people concerned have. It applies to students, their parents or guardians, and school staff who use the application.

sections.heading: 2. Controller and data protection officer
paragraphs: The controller is Internationale Deutsche Schule Sarajevo (IDSS): Private institution "INTERNATIONALE DEUTSCHE SCHULE SARAJEVO" - Međunarodna Njemačka Škola Sarajevo, Buka 13, 71000 Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina; ID number 4202220420007; registration number (MBSU) 65-05-0013-16; telephone +387 33 560 520; info@idss.ba; www.idss.edu.ba.
IDSS has appointed a data protection officer. For all questions and requests concerning personal data, contact the officer: gdpr@idss.ba, telephone +387 33 267 965.
For technical questions about the application: ai@idss.ba.

sections.heading: 3. Legal framework
paragraphs: We process personal data in accordance with the Law on Personal Data Protection of Bosnia and Herzegovina (Official Gazette of BiH, No. 12/25), which is aligned with the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union (Regulation (EU) 2016/679, GDPR). We apply the GDPR principles throughout the application: lawfulness, fairness and transparency, purpose limitation, data minimisation, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity and confidentiality, and accountability.

sections.heading: 4. Data we process
items: Account data: first and last name, username (for staff the official e-mail address), role, account status, assigned rights and the teacher's subject.
Learning data: answers to tasks, results of practice and mock examinations, teachers' grades and comments, progress by area, points, missions and awards.

Security data: sign-in and sign-out times, failed sign-in attempts (the username is kept only as a one-way cryptographic fingerprint), the IP address with important actions and a record of important actions (who did what and when).
Search data: for each search we keep only a cryptographic fingerprint of the query, not the text itself.
We do not process special categories of personal data (such as health data, religious or ethnic origin) and we do not create personality profiles.

sections.heading: 5. Purposes and legal bases
items: Preparing students for the external examination (practice, mock examinations, progress tracking, grading and teacher feedback): the educational activity of IDSS based on the student's enrolment and the consent of parents or guardians given through the school's enrolment documents.
Managing accounts and access rights for students and staff: the same basis as above; for staff, the employment relationship with IDSS.

Security of the application and data (protection against unauthorised access, locking after failed sign-ins, record of actions): the legitimate interest of IDSS and the controller's legal obligation to ensure appropriate security of processing.
Remembering the chosen interface language: necessary to provide the service requested by the user.

sections.heading: 6. Children's data
paragraphs: Grade 9 students are minors. We process their data only to the extent necessary for the educational purpose of the application. Students' data protection rights are exercised by their parents or guardians, and students may exercise them themselves according to their maturity. The application shows no advertising to students and does not use their data for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: 7. Who has access to data
paragraphs: Access is strictly limited by role and is enforced on the server and in the database, not only in the display:
items: students see only their own data;
teachers see student data only for the subject they teach;
specialist staff and school management have access only within their duties;
every access and every important action is recorded.

sections.heading: 8. Processors and recipients
paragraphs: IDSS uses reliable service providers (processors) to run the application. They process data only on the instructions of IDSS and for the purposes stated in this policy:
items: Supabase: database, sign-in and document storage; data is stored on servers in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany).
Vercel: hosting of the web application; processes technical data needed to deliver pages (such as the IP address and technical logs).

Google (Gemini API): semantic search and explanations based on official materials. Google receives only the text of the official examination catalogues and the text of search queries, never a name, username, results or other account data.

sections.heading: 9. Transfers outside Bosnia and Herzegovina
paragraphs: The application's database is located in the European Union, where the GDPR applies. Technical hosting data and search query text may also be processed outside the European Union by the providers named above; this data does not identify students. Any transfer of personal data takes place only with the safeguards required by law.

sections.heading: 10. How long we keep data
items: Student data is kept until the end of the school year in which the student completed Grade 9 and for one further year. The account is then closed and the personal data is deleted or permanently anonymised; only anonymous statistics without any link to a person remain.
Staff data is kept while the person works at IDSS and uses the application.
Security records and the record of actions are kept for the periods required by law.

sections.heading: 11. Your rights
paragraphs: Under the law you have the right:
items: to access your data and receive a copy;
to rectification of inaccurate and completion of incomplete data;
to erasure when there is no longer a basis for processing;
to restriction of processing;
to portability of the data you provided, in a structured, commonly used format;
to object to processing based on legitimate interest;
to withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal;
not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing.

sections.heading: 12. How to exercise your rights
paragraphs: Send your request to the data protection officer at gdpr@idss.ba. To protect your data we may ask you to confirm your identity. We respond without undue delay and within the time limits set by law, as a rule within one month at the latest. Exercising your rights is free of charge.

If you believe your data is processed unlawfully, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Agency in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Dubrovačka 6, 71000 Sarajevo, azlpinfo@azlp.ba, www.azlp.ba. We recommend contacting our officer first so that we can resolve the issue as quickly as possible.

sections.heading: 13. Automated decision-making
paragraphs: The application makes no decisions about students without human involvement. For closed tasks the system may propose points, but the grade of a mock examination is always confirmed by the teacher. The application draws no conclusions about students' personality, health or abilities.

sections.heading: 14. Data security
paragraphs: We apply technical and organisational measures appropriate to the risk, including:
items: an encrypted connection (HTTPS) for all traffic between browser and server;
passwords are stored only as a one-way cryptographic fingerprint and never in readable form;
role-based and row level security rules in the database, denying any access that is not explicitly allowed;
locking after repeated failed sign-ins;
a record of all important actions that cannot be changed or deleted;
official documents are kept in private storage with integrity checks;
the minimum necessary amount of data and limited staff access.

sections.heading: 15. Personal data breaches
paragraphs: If a personal data breach occurs, IDSS will assess it without delay, take measures to mitigate its consequences and, where the law requires, notify the Personal Data Protection Agency within 72 hours of becoming aware of it. If the breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights of the people concerned, we will also inform them, or the parents or guardians of students.

sections.heading: 16. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We keep this policy in line with regulations and the development of the application. We inform users of material changes in the application before they take effect. The current version and its date are shown at the end of the document.

sections.heading: 1. Usage model
paragraphs: The application IDSS - External Graduate Examination is free of charge for students of Internationale Deutsche Schule Sarajevo. Its use is part of the IDSS educational programme and requires no separate subscription, contract or payment.

sections.heading: 2. What is included
items: access to reviewed tasks in all three examination subjects;
practice with solutions after the answer is submitted;
mock examinations graded by the subject teacher;
progress tracking by area, missions and awards;
search of official materials.

sections.heading: 3. Payments
paragraphs: The application has no payments, in-app purchases, automatic renewals or advertising. IDSS never asks users of the application for card or bank account details. If anyone asks you for a payment or payment details on behalf of the application, it is a fraud attempt; please report it to ai@idss.ba.

sections.heading: 4. Duration of access
paragraphs: The school opens the account at the start of preparation. Students use the application during Grade 9. After the end of the school year the account is closed, and data is kept and deleted within the periods set out in the Privacy Policy. Staff accounts last while the person works at IDSS and uses the application.

sections.heading: 5. End of access
paragraphs: Access ends when a student leaves IDSS, when the period of use ends, or when the account is closed because of a breach of the Terms of Use. The end of access creates no financial obligation.

sections.heading: 6. Future changes
paragraphs: Should IDSS ever offer the application to users outside the school for a fee, the terms of such a subscription will be published separately and in advance, and no fee will be charged without the user's explicit agreement. For current IDSS students use remains free of charge.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about use: ai@idss.ba.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in the browser. The browser's local storage is a similar store on your device. The application uses both only as far as necessary for it to work.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies and entries we use
items: Sign-in cookie (name starts with sb-): strictly necessary; keeps you signed in and protects against session misuse. It expires when you sign out or after 12 hours at the latest.
Language cookie (ege_locale): functional; remembers the chosen interface language (Bosnian, German or English). It lasts up to one year.

Local storage (idss-ege:splash:last-message): functional; remembers the last message of the start screen so that the same message is not repeated. It contains no personal data and does not expire until you delete it.

sections.heading: 3. What we do not use
paragraphs: We use no cookies for advertising, analytics, profiling or tracking across websites, and we load no third-party content that sets such cookies. That is why the application does not ask for cookie consent.

sections.heading: 4. Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies and local storage at any time in your browser settings. If you block the sign-in cookie, signing in to the application is not possible; after deleting the language cookie you choose the language again.

sections.heading: 5. Changes and contact
paragraphs: If we introduce new cookies, we update this notice before using them and ask for consent in advance for cookies that are not necessary.
Questions: ai@idss.ba. Questions about personal data: gdpr@idss.ba, telephone +387 33 267 965.
